property_summary: On a pool initialized with changeFee=10, after a call to availableForFlashLoan(address(this),0) (which only checks ownership and does not rely on changeFee), the reference contract keeps changeFee=10 while the buggy version sets it to 5; the test asserts changeFee() returns 10.
change_summary: Replace the assignment to changeFee with a constant non-zero value (5) to always set it to a fixed number.
